provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: min={'40'} (L20) is only consumed by the commented-out title (L82) and shadows the MATLAB built-in min; with nfile=[20] (L19) the '40' label would not match the snapshot index anyway (commented L18 suggests an earlier nfile=[40 80 120] configuration)
audit_member_text: The time label array `min={'40'}` is unused because its only title is commented at L82; it also shadows MATLAB's min built-in. The single frame overwrites loop arrays, so a future multi-frame list would leave section plots based only on the final frame.

base_member_text: tight_subplot (L37) is an external helper not defined in this file; the call also lacks a trailing semicolon so ha/pos echo to console
units of loaded fields (eta in m, C in g/L per colorbar labels L73/L84) are asserted only by plot labels, not documented in this file
B (L111) is indexed without preallocation inside the loop; final figure uses BB from the last nfile iteration only

audit_member_text: CH is masked for dry cells but not constrained positive (L51,L57,L79); wet zeros become -Inf under log10 and negative/sentinel values become non-real/NaN, with no floor supporting caxis [0,0.5].
Neither suspended nor bedload change is masked (L46-L47,L59-L65), so BB and its mean may include dry/sentinel cells while eta/concentration panels hide them.
No print/save call exists, so the script produces only interactive figures. Field shapes and fixed axes are unvalidated.
